card.name: The word urine in lab monitoring
card.fires_on: The word "urine" (rarely "plasma") when it names a sample or test being monitored, such as urine protein, urine cell counts or urine glucose, in monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Urine tests
modes.description: "urine" begins a test or measurement name, such as protein, cell counts, glucose or cortisol.
modes.example: Monitor<< urine>> protein regularly during OMCAZIO treatment

modes.label: Repeated urine after urinalysis
modes.description: "urine" follows "urinalysis with" and introduces cell counts.
modes.example: urinalysis with<< urine>> cell counts monthly until 48 months

modes.label: Plasma levels
modes.description: The related word "plasma" appears before a lab measurement.
modes.example: hemodynamic parameters or<< plasma>> catecholamine levels, either at

card.writes: It pushes away blood and plasma words, so the next word is less likely to be a blood-sample term.
card.plain: It marks the word urine when a label tells you to check urine tests, and steers the text away from blood terms.
